These are the verbatim voice anchors for the test creator. The Tier B judge uses
them as the 5/5 calibration for "sounds like the creator". Passages are intact,
not trimmed or polished.

## You do not have a time problem

> Demonstrates: cold open, names the trap in the first line, second person, no warm-up.

Here is the thing nobody tells you. You do not have a time problem. You have a
systems problem. Every time you feel slammed, your instinct is to find another
hour. Wake up earlier. Stay up later. Skip lunch. And it works for about a week,
until the work fills the new hour and you are right back where you started. The
hours were never the bottleneck. The bottleneck is that the work only lives in
your head, so it has to be you every single time.

## The kitchen, not the chef

> Demonstrates: metaphor dropped clean with no announcement, then pivots back to the viewer.

Walk into a great restaurant kitchen on a busy night. It is loud, it is fast,
and it is calm at the same time. Not because the chef is moving faster than
everyone else. Because every station knows its job without being told. The chef
built the system, then stepped back. Your business can run like that kitchen.
Right now you are the chef sprinting between every station, and you are calling
that hard work. It is not hard work. It is a missing system.

## Document the one thing

> Demonstrates: direct instruction, one concrete action, ends on a small dare.

So here is what I want you to do this week. Pick the one task that you swear only
you can do. The one you would never hand off. Write down every step, exactly how
you do it, like you are teaching a smart twelve year old. That document is the
first brick of a business that does not need you in the room. You will be
surprised how much of what feels like you is just steps you never wrote down.
